proposal.summary: The Wavlink WN533A8 firmware exposes administrative credentials in plaintext on a publicly accessible sysinit.shtml page (version M33A8.V5030.190716). No authentication is required to view the page.
proposal.cwe_quote:
search for var syspasswd="
you will find the username and the password

C.quote: you will find the username and the password

I.quote: you will find the username and the password

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the issue by fetching /sysinit.shtml from a device running the stated firmware, confirm credentials exposure, and coordinate disclosure with the vendor to remove plaintext credentials from publicly accessible pages and rotate exposed credentials.
